title: Core Protocol Architecture — sector_attributes
description: Fields shared by every subsector in Core Protocol Architecture (Consensus Layer, Execution Layer, Validators & Staking Providers, MEV & Block Builders, Network Upgrades).

maintaining_organization.title: Maintaining organization
maintaining_organization.description: The org or team that owns / maintains the entity (e.g. 'Ethereum Foundation', 'Sigma Prime', 'Prysmatic Labs').

entity_type.title: Entity type
entity_type.description: What kind of thing this is. 'Protocol Specification (Normative)' is reserved for canonical, spec-level entries.

supported_networks.title: Supported networks
supported_networks.description: Semicolon-separated list of chains / networks this entity supports.

license.title: License
license.description: SPDX-like identifier for the entity's source license (e.g. 'apache-2.0', 'mit', 'gpl-3.0-or-later', 'cc-by-4.0', 'proprietary').

production_status.title: Production status
production_status.description: Maturity / deployment status. 'canonical' is reserved for authoritative specs.

reason_for_inclusion.title: Reason for inclusion
reason_for_inclusion.description: Why this entity belongs in the Market Map. Multi-line markdown-ish text from the source sheet.

practitioner_note.title: Practitioner note
practitioner_note.description: Editorial commentary from the CanHav research team.

practitioner_validation_check.title: Practitioner validation check
practitioner_validation_check.description: Counter-factual / what-if-this-disappeared check, used to justify inclusion.
